concerns.text: FR-005 (Data Cleaning) requires validation against `contracts/session.schema.yaml`. Task T019d (Runtime Integration) is marked incomplete `[ ]`. Without this, the data integrity gate for FR-005 is not implemented, leaving the spec requirement unfulfilled.

FR-002 (Statistical Analysis Engine) mandates Repeated Measures ANOVA. Task T023a (Implement Repeated Measures ANOVA) is marked incomplete `[ ]`. Downstream tasks (T025c-orch, T105) depend on it. The core statistical engine required by the spec is missing.

FR-006 (Power Analysis) requires computing statistical power. Task T036 (Implement PowerCalculator) is marked incomplete `[ ]`. The plan and spec require this output to determine sample sufficiency, but the implementation task is not complete.

FR-001 (Data Collection) and NFR-001 (Reproducibility) require visualizations. Tasks T027a, T027b, T027c (Visualization) are marked incomplete `[ ]`. The reporting phase cannot produce required figures without these tasks.

NFR-002 (Data Integrity) requires the pipeline to fail if real data is missing. Task T019d (Runtime Integration of validator) is incomplete, and T097 (Production Gate) depends on T019b/T025a but the critical path for validation logic (T019d) is blocked.
FR-002 requires Holm-Bonferroni correction. Task T024 implements this, but it depends on T023a (ANOVA) which is incomplete. The correction cannot be applied without the primary test results.

FR-005 requires SUS imputation. Task T021b implements logic, but T025d (Final Report) is incomplete `[ ]` and depends on T023a. The verification of the data cleaning requirement via the final report is missing.
Task T124 (Cleanup Phase 13) depends on T123 (Document Power Analysis Limitations), which is marked incomplete `[ ]`. The cleanup phase cannot be verified while its dependency is unresolved.
Task T033 is marked [DEPRECATED] but still listed in the active task list. It should be removed or moved to a dedicated 'Archived' section to avoid confusion about active work items.
